title: Emsculpt Neo® For Calves
paragraphs: Trying hard at the gym to get toned calves is challenging. If you’ve tried several exercises, such as double leg lifts, seated leg lifts, or simply walking and using stairs, and found no substantial benefits. Remember, toning and muscle building can be complex even with the workout. Despite all the efforts, do you feel you didn’t get any help from it and are disappointed! If your goal is to get toned calves, you can get it in no time if you’ve heard of Emsculpt Neo®. It is an FDA-cleared and non-invasive body contouring technique that helps strengthen and tone the calves with small new applicators. The new FDA-cleared device works the same way as the original and uses high-intensity electromagnetic energy to tone your muscles.
There are several benefits of Emsculpt Neo® for calves –

Works better than your rigorous workout – You are likely to get better results than your most rigorous workout. Imagine trying to do 20,000 leg curls or presses in one session; it’s impossible, isn’t it! But Emsculpt Neo® can help you achieve those results in no time.

Non-invasive procedure – It only targets muscle, so cutting the skin is unnecessary. It has become one of the most popular alternatives to surgeries like liposuction, tummy tuck, and butt implants because it offers the same outcome with no risk. Patients do not require anesthesia during the treatment, and it is painless.
Short sessions – It is a 30 min session that you can manage while taking a break from the office or on a break from other appointments.

Faster results – Treatments generally include four sessions during a 2-3 week period with profound effects after each visit. Usually, the patients continue to see an improvement for up to six months after the last session.

Athletes can reap the benefits – For athletes, it is highly beneficial as Emsculpt Neo® helps rebuild and strengthen the muscle after an injury which will help in your recovery and getting back in the game.

There is no beforehand preparation required for the appointment as it is a non-invasive procedure. The process is entirely painless. It is a 30min procedure where we strap the device panels onto your targeted area (calf). The doctor turns the device to its lowest setting. The patient experiences contractions for a few seconds now and then. They are super-intense vibrations that reach your core. We will check in regularly to see if you are comfortable. The practitioner then increases the intensity gradually, depending on your comfort level. The results vary depending from person to person.
